speaker: CIVILIAN AMARA
text: My name is Amara. Look at the terminal... it's not red anymore. It knows who I am.

speaker: CIVILIANS
text: I'm Elias. My family is on the manifest. We're on the board!

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Biometric carrier wave is completely flatlined. Not a single camera knows how to track them now.

speaker: AURA
text: The frequency in the air changed. The static in their comms... it isn't fear anymore. It's a chorus.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Transit gates are opening. Water filtration and ration vaults unlocked. They're finally treated as people, not contraband.

speaker: TITAN
text: The occupation spent five years building those locks. Took us five minutes to tear the teeth out of them.

speaker: SURYA // COMMS
text: Kaito, you did it! The outer barrier just dropped. The entire queue is crossing over. Nobody is being turned away!

speaker: KAITO
text: Let them come. The people have their names back. Now, we take the rest of the city. Squad—fall in.
